prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original aquarium animal cutout for a mobile game and 3D modelling reference. Photorealistic natural-history wildlife photograph of a real marine or river mammal, scientifically credible anatomy and proportions, natural small dark eyes, authentic fur or skin microtexture (wet sleek fur lying flat along the body, individual guard hairs only as fine texture), soft even upper-left daylight. Single whole living animal swimming UNDERWATER in a neutral straight horizontal pose, side view, head pointing RIGHT and tail or hind flippers pointing LEFT, belly down, body fully extended, all four limbs or flippers fully visible and not hidden behind the body, 10% empty padding on all sides, square 1024x1024. Genuine transparent alpha background. NOT cartoon, NOT chibi, NOT an illustration, NOT a plush toy or plastic render, no human expression, no smiling mouth, no oversized eyes, no water surface, bubbles, rocks, ice, scenery, ground, shadows, text or watermark. Even soft diffuse light: NO painted specular highlight streaks, wet-glare bands or white shine patches on the back, head or flanks. Natural colouring with the back colour continuing all the way to the top edge of the body. Clean natural silhouette edge with no dark outline stroke or halo. Mouth closed with the mouth line clearly visible, nostrils closed (underwater). Whiskers (vibrissae) visible but short and slightly blurred into the muzzle, never long thin lines standing out from the head. Fore flippers or forelegs drawn relaxed and swept back along the body; hind flippers or hind feet spread behind the body like a tail fin and fully visible. Eye painted naturally — it stays painted on the texture.
Subject: Fully grown adult sea otter (Enhydra lutris): very dense dark brown fur, pale grizzled cream-grey head and neck, small rounded ears, blunt muzzle, short flattened tail, large webbed flipper-like hind feet spread behind, small forepaws tucked against the chest.
Only ONE animal, genuine alpha transparency. No checkerboard painted into pixels.
